title: U Cinn - Phospholipids Assay
author: Patrick Tso
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xmvfk66

steps.title: Prepare working standards
steps.instruction: Create working standards by performing a serial dilution of the 300mg/dl stock standard provided in the kit.

steps.title: Prepare Working Reagent
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the Color Reagent and mix with Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute one vial of Color Reagent with a portion of Buffer.
Transfer the entire contents of the reconstituted reagent into the Buffer bottle.
Rinse the Color Reagent vial several times into the Buffer bottle.

steps.title: Load samples and standards
steps.instruction: Pipette 2μL of deionized water, standard, or sample into separate wells of a 96 well flat bottom plate.

steps.title: Add Working Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 300μL of Working Reagent to all wells of the plate.

steps.title: Incubate plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Determine the absorbance (abs) of the standards and each unknown at 600nm.

steps.title: Calculate unknown values
steps.instruction: Calculate the values of the unknowns using the generated standard curve.
